title: Mexico: New retail formats and players gain ground
summary: Pet-related businesses in Mexico grew 5.2% between 2023 and 2025, with 42,600 registered companies in the country last year. Data from the National Statistical Directory of Economic Units (DENUE), published by the Nation…
ai_summary: Mexico sees growth in pet-related businesses, with a 5.2% increase between 2023 and 2025 and 42,600 registered companies last year. The data comes from the National Statistical Directory of Economic Units (DENUE) published by the Nation.
